preface: This test is to confirm a passenger's first alighting-stop correction in a calendar month is accepted (CR122, mechanism unconfirmed; limit is 1/month, 3/year).
preconds:
**GIVEN** a settled Tap-On-Only journey on the seeded card with no prior alighting-stop correction this calendar month (limit 1/month, 3/year)
**AND** you are signed in to the ABT Passenger Portal viewing the card's Journey History
**AND** example: 72b (IN) Moygashel Busby Shop → Armagh Bus Centre (£4.50), to be corrected to alight earlier at Greys Farm (£1.90 — **UNCONFIRMED** fare, not verified against a fares export; gap Q14)
**AND** **UNCONFIRMED** — CR122 alighting-stop correction UX is TBD; confirm the feature exists live (gap Q21)

steps.content: **WHEN** you open the journey, correct the alighting stop to Greys Farm and confirm
steps.expected: **THEN** the correction is accepted (within the 1/month, 3/year limit) — **UNCONFIRMED** (CR122)

steps.content: **WHEN** the next EndOfDay settlement runs and you re-open the journey
steps.expected: **THEN** the journey fare is recalculated for the new alighting stop — **UNCONFIRMED** (CR122)

preface: This test is to confirm a second alighting-stop correction in the same calendar month is refused (CR122, mechanism unconfirmed; limit is 1/month).
preconds:
**GIVEN** the seeded card has already had one accepted alighting-stop correction this calendar month
**AND** you are signed in to the ABT Passenger Portal viewing the card's Journey History
**AND** example: a second correction attempted on a settled 72b (IN) Greys Farm → Armagh Bus Centre journey (£4.50) in the same month
**AND** **UNCONFIRMED** — CR122 correction UX is TBD; the refusal behaviour (a warning message) is confirmed only for the analogous TOTO missing-tap correction, not CR122 itself; confirm live (gap Q21)

steps.content: **WHEN** you attempt a second alighting-stop correction in the same calendar month and confirm
steps.expected:
**THEN** the correction is refused because the monthly limit of one is reached — **UNCONFIRMED** (CR122)
**AND** the journey keeps its previous alighting stop and fare
